evidence.sql: WITH cust_rev AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, dc.customer_name, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS customer_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc ON fi.customer_id = dc.customer_id WHERE YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2025 GROUP BY fi.customer_id, dc.customer_name), total AS (SELECT SUM(customer_revenue) AS total_rev FROM cust_rev), ranked AS (SELECT customer_id, customer_name, customer_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY customer_revenue DESC) AS rnk FROM cust_rev) SELECT (SELECT SUM(customer_revenue) FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 1) / (SELECT total_rev FROM total) * 100 AS top1_pct, (SELECT SUM(customer_revenue) FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 3) / (SELECT total_rev FROM total) * 100 AS top3_pct, (SELECT SUM(customer_revenue) FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 5) / (SELECT total_rev FROM total) * 100 AS top5_pct, (SELECT SUM(customer_revenue) FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 10) / (SELECT total_rev FROM total) * 100 AS top10_pct, (SELECT total_rev FROM total) AS total_revenue

evidence.sql: WITH starting_cohort AS (SELECT customer_id, arr_usd AS starting_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = '2024-12-01' AND arr_usd > 0), ending_cohort AS (SELECT customer_id, arr_usd AS ending_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = '2025-12-01'), cohort_ending AS (SELECT sc.customer_id, sc.starting_arr, COALESCE(ec.ending_arr, 0) AS ending_arr FROM starting_cohort sc LEFT JOIN ending_cohort ec ON sc.customer_id = ec.customer_id), grr_calc AS (SELECT customer_id, starting_arr, ending_arr, LEAST(ending_arr, starting_arr) AS retained_arr_grr FROM cohort_ending) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sc.customer_id) AS starting_cohort_count, SUM(sc.starting_arr) AS starting_arr_total, SUM(ce.ending_arr) AS ending_arr_total, SUM(ce.ending_arr) / SUM(sc.starting_arr) * 100 AS nrr_pct, SUM(g.retained_arr_grr) AS retained_arr_grr, SUM(g.retained_arr_grr) / SUM(sc.starting_arr) * 100 AS grr_pct FROM starting_cohort sc JOIN cohort_ending ce ON sc.customer_id = ce.customer_id JOIN grr_calc g ON sc.customer_id = g.customer_id
